meta.title: Rural Broadband Fix — Oregon
meta.program: Oregon BEAD (Broadband Equity, Access, and Deployment)
meta.note: Per-ZIP unserved-location counts are not yet included. They require the FCC Broadband Data Collection bulk file, which needs a free FCC account to download (see build_data.py). ZIP lookup currently shows county, area, and rural character from Census data; cost math uses verified statewide figures.

sources.fcc_benchmark: FCC 24-27 (Mar 14, 2024): 100/20 Mbps benchmark; confirmed current Apr 29, 2026 (DOC-421212A1)
sources.bead_definitions: IIJA / NTIA BEAD NOFO: unserved = <25/3 Mbps; underserved = <100/20 Mbps
sources.oregon_bead_plan: Oregon BEAD Final Proposal, NTIA-approved Feb 4, 2026 (Business Oregon press release; Benton Institute)
sources.oregon_tech_mix: Oregon Legislature committee briefing on Final Proposal (2026R1)
sources.oregon_timeline: IIJA 60102(h)(4)(C) 4-year build requirement; OBO: contracts signed by Sep 18, 2026; most construction late 2026
sources.starlink_monthly: Starlink price increase effective June 18, 2026 (Talk Android, Prism News, RV Mobile Internet Resource Center)
sources.starlink_rental: Starlink hardware rental model launched June 2026
sources.louisiana_bead: ConnectLA revised final proposal, NTIA-approved Nov 2025 (via BroadbandBreakfast, Pelican Policy Institute)
sources.zip_geography: U.S. Census Bureau: 2023 Gazetteer (ZCTA land area/centroid); 2020 ZCTA-to-County relationship file

secondary_benchmark.basis: Louisiana revised BEAD plan average (blended across technologies), NTIA-approved Nov 2025
